validationNote: Native Chromium decoding and waveform measurements verify non-silent playable audio, not linguistic accuracy or human listening review.
post: carrier "Here is the word... {word}." then "The word is... {word}." cut at the pause before the word (the bare word when no clean cut) + trim(0.3% peak, 60ms/120ms margins, 5ms/30ms fades) + loudness -20 LUFS over the word (BS.1770, true peak <= -1.5 dBTP) + ffmpeg libopus 64kbps mono webm
